steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary containing two bids.
Ensure the project withdrawal action is visible for the test tenant.
Ensure eRFX project events are enabled for the prepared RFQ.
Attempt to withdraw the live project while leaving the withdrawal reason empty.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Verify Procol refuses the withdrawal with the required-reason message.
Verify the project remains withdrawable, confirming that the failed attempt made no state change.
